name: Gray Login Customizer
author: graywp

sections.description:
Gray Login Customizer allows you to personalize your WordPress login page with ease. Whether you’re branding for a client or improving your own site’s aesthetics, this plugin helps you design the login screen without touching code.

Features:
– Upload a custom logo
– Change background color or image
– Customize login form styles (border, color, etc.)
– Custom login button design
– Lightweight and optimized for performance

Perfect for developers, agencies, and site owners who want to deliver a better login experience.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Appearance > Customize > Login Customizer or Settings > Gray Login Customizer to configure your options.
sections.faq:
Can I use this plugin on client websites?

Absolutely! This plugin is licensed under GPL, so you can use it for personal or commercial use.

Does it work with all themes?

Yes, it works independently of your theme.

Will it slow down my website?

No. It only affects the login screen and does not load on the frontend or admin dashboard.
